create_rms_norm_layer: create an RMSNorm layer with a given dimension and optional weight parameter
run_rms_norm_forward: run rms_norm on a contiguous tensor with optional weight and epsilon value
run_rms_norm_add: run rms_norm_add to fuse tensor addition with RMS normalization
test_rms_norm_layer: test the RMSNorm module forward pass on a contiguous input tensor
review_rms_norm_add_method: review the RMSNorm increment_and_forward_ method that fuses addition with normalization
